title: Cascading lookup (dependsOn) broken in forms: stays gated after parent is chosen; table picker bypasses the dependent filter
body:
Found while dogfooding `examples/app-showcase` in the framework repo (showcase_invoice: `contact` is `Field.lookup('showcase_contact', { dependsOn: ['account'] })`). Two independent breaks, both confirmed by source scan + browser repro against a source build.

## Symptom 1 — dependent lookup stays gated forever after the parent is selected

Repro: New Invoice modal → pick an Account (chip "Northwind" shows) → the Contact lookup still renders the gated trigger "请先选择account" (`data-testid="lookup-trigger-gated"`, disabled).

Root cause — the dependent values the gate reads are never the live form values:

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx:287-290` — `resolvedDependentValues = dependentValuesProp ?? ctx.formValues ?? ctx.data`.
- `SchemaRendererContext` has **no `formValues` member at all** (`packages/react/src/context/SchemaRendererContext.tsx` — zero hits), so `ctx.formValues` is always `undefined` — dead code.
- The form renderer never injects the `dependentValues` prop: `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx:719-730` passes `dataSource: contextDataSource` to the field widget but no `dependentValues`; `stripRegisteredFieldProps` (form.tsx:135-153) merely *forwards* the prop for `lookup`/`master_detail`/`tree` if someone upstream set it — nobody does.
- Net: the gate falls back to `ctx.data` (static record scope). In create mode that's `{}`, so `dependenciesMissing` (LookupField.tsx:295-301) is permanently `true` → the field can never be filled. In edit mode it's the *saved* record, so changing the parent in-form doesn't re-scope the child.

The form renderer already maintains a live watched snapshot for CEL rules (`ruleRecord`, form.tsx:275-288) — it just never hands it to lookup widgets.

## Symptom 2 — the Level-2 table picker (browse-all) bypasses the cascade entirely

Repro: same modal, Account = Northwind already chosen → click the browse-all button next to Contact → dialog lists **121 records, page 1/13**: Contoso/Fabrikam contacts, pagination-test contacts — everything. (It also opens fine while the field is still gated.)

Root cause:

- The dependent filter chain is only applied to the quick-select popover query (`popoverFilter`, LookupField.tsx:375-394).
- `RecordPickerDialog` gets only the static `lookupFilters` (LookupField.tsx:1098-1116) — the `dependsOn` chain is never merged in.
- The browse-all button (LookupField.tsx:1080-1091) has no `disabled={dependenciesMissing}`, unlike the main trigger (:807).

## Fix direction

1. `form.tsx`: pass the live watched record (`ruleRecord`) as `dependentValues` to data-source field widgets, so the gate and the popover re-scope reactively.
2. `LookupField.tsx`: merge the `dependsOn` chain (param → value as `eq` filters) into what `RecordPickerDialog` receives, and gate the browse-all button on `dependenciesMissing` like the main trigger.
